question_set.question: Use change_encoding with field equal to money and use sort_bars with order equal to descending and use highlight_top_n with n equal to 2 in order to know How do coffee sales patterns vary across different times of day, and which coffee types perform best in each period?

answer.value: Coffee sales show distinct patterns across time periods. Night has the highest total sales at $38,186.34, followed closely by Afternoon at $38,130.04, with Morning slightly lower at $35,929.20. Different coffee types have peak performance at different times: Americano with Milk dominates Morning sales ($10,025.52, 40.5% of its total), Latte performs consistently well in both Afternoon and Night (around $9,600 each), Cappuccino peaks in Night ($7,201, 41.3%), Hot Chocolate is overwhelmingly popular at Night ($5,290, 53.3%), while Cortado is most popular in Morning ($3,605, 48.8%). This suggests customers prefer different coffee types based on time of day, with milky drinks favored in morning and richer options in evening.

key_insights: Night period has highest total sales but only marginally ahead of Afternoon
Americano with Milk is the clear morning favorite with 40.5% of sales in morning
Hot Chocolate shows strongest time preference with 53.3% of sales at Night
Latte maintains consistent performance across Afternoon and Night periods
Cortado is primarily a morning drink with 48.8% of sales in morning
Cappuccino and Espresso show different time preferences with Cappuccino stronger at night and Espresso stronger in afternoon

reasoning_trace.rationale: Change encoding to Time_of_Day on x-axis to compare time periods
Sort bars by sales to identify top performers in each period
Highlight top 5 coffees to see which types dominate sales
